start_basis: Conservative existing E2amend4 admission retained for a100GiB cap and12GiB system reserve.
cache_external_conflict_behavior: do not invoke when external GPU, service, observation, or memory precheck is not CLEAR

kernel_watch.freshness: Initial historical entry establishes cursor only, never triggers; subsequent entries are checked before each guard observation.
kernel_watch.on_trigger: Stop the owned systemd worker through existing finally cleanup; ENGINE_STOPPED_NVRM; no retry.
kernel_watch.unreadable: Initial permission denial, absent/unsupported journal reader, or no readable cursor: UNAVAILABLE_CONTINUE. Unexpected initial read/parse/timeout errors and any read failure after AVAILABLE: OBSERVATION_FAILED, stop.

limits: Kernel polling cannot guarantee recovery if the driver or host stops responding before userspace can observe it.
